title: Evaluation preserved by eliminating constants
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with $n>0$ inputs. Suppose every gate is well formed, every NOT gate has exactly one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments. For every Boolean input assignment, the circuit obtained by eliminating constants has the same output as $C$.
hypotheses_covered: Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
Every gate has at most two arguments
An arbitrary Boolean assignment to the $n$ inputs
